So happy with the exceptional service I received for my 2yr old Dachshund during an emergency whilst visiting my mum just down the road. Not only did the staff go over and above to ensure my girl was safe and we were well informed of local emergency services but the care and attention she received was next to none. Pricing was transparent and very reasonable, just wish this was my local vets as they are just so friendly and welcoming and Binky actually came out of surgery wagging her tail and seemed happy to have a mooch around reception whilst I settled up. Would highly recommend this practice especially if like me you have a dog that is very anxious and has separation anxiety.
Many thanks to all the lovely staff at Medivet.

If you want an expensive vet who doesn’t care about your pet then you will hit the jackpot with Medivet Streatham.

The only positive is the warm and welcoming receptionist. Everything else is just a money making scheme. My cat had an injury. On visit 1. We saw a vet, they examined the wound and gave 2 different medications. They told us to come back in a week so see if there was improvement which we did. We saw a different vet, they changed the medication at great expense. Again we were told to come a week later. We did and again a different vet. This vet did not even look at the wound but referred us to Medivets specialist in Kent with an astronomical consulting fee.

On making a complaint at the treatment we had received we waited 3 weeks for a response which very much had the feel chat GPT had written it.

We are now with an independent vet who gace my cat a medical injection and in less than a week he had dramatically improved. They asked us to email photos which we did and they didn’t ask us to come for another appointment just to profit from his pain.

I had heard horror stories of Vets bought out by corporations but experiencing it whilst my poor cat was in pain is shocking. Be very cautious with this vet.
Very friendly and professional.

Best vet ever imo. Very knowledgeable, helpful and patient. Can't understand the negative reviews - my own experience could not have been more different. Their pet plan (£15 per month) for routine treatments is the bargain of the century - covers vaccinations, flea treatment, worm treatment and claw clipping -) My cat who normally kicks off at the slightest opportunity is calm, no drama, no hissing, no distress throughout. Full marks for Vale Vets!

Their care, organisation and structure is shambolic and they really do not care about your pet (albeit not the receptionists). Their main focus is how can they extract more money from you. I’m quite shocked to see there are good reviews on here for them.  Even when they say they’ll call you back they send you an email two days later to email and write your concerns and they’ll get back to you in 15 working days…a joke.

We had the privilege of rehoming a cat from the vets and she has been a joy ever since we got her last year.  Recently she had to go in for a procedure and the whole experience from start to finish has been easy. Really lovely staff too.
